Shareholders holding a total of 20,642,027 Shares were represented in person or by proxy at the Meeting, representing 77.12% of the 26,766,269 issued and outstanding Shares entitled to vote as of August 28, 2026, the record date for the Meeting. Optionholders and Warrantholders holding a combined 3,353,750 combined Options and Warrants were also represented in person or by proxy at the Meeting.
The special resolution approving the Arrangement (the "

") required the approval of (i) at least 66⅔% of the votes cast on the Arrangement Resolution by all Shareholders present in person or represented by proxy at the Meeting; (ii) at least 66⅔% of the votes cast on the Arrangement Resolution by all Securityholders present in person or represented by proxy at the Meeting, voting together as a single class; and (iii) a majority of votes cast on the Arrangement Resolution by disinterested Shareholders present in person or by proxy at the Meeting, as required under Multilateral Instrument 61-101 -
Protection of Minority Security Holders in Special Transactions
and the policies of the TSX Venture Exchange (the "
"). Each of the foregoing thresholds was exceeded.

Of the votes cast at the Meeting, 99.96% of the votes cast by all Shareholders were in favour of the Arrangement Resolution, 99.96% of the votes cast by all Securityholders were in favour of the Arrangement Resolution, and 99.96% of the votes cast by disinterested Shareholders were in favour of the Arrangement Resolution.

All other motions tabled at the Meeting, including the election of Sai Huda, Steven Kohler, Shawn Balaghi and Scott Tait to the board of directors of the Company and the appointment of Charlton & Company as the Company's auditor, also passed. Completion of the Arrangement is subject to the satisfaction of customary closing conditions for a transaction of this nature, including final approval of the TSXV and receipt of the final order from the Supreme Court of British Columbia. Subject to the satisfaction (or waiver) of the closing conditions, it is expected that the Arrangement will be completed in the fourth quarter of 2026.

(OTCQB: CYBHF) provides a proprietary, AI-enabled Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) solution that provides continuous compliance and cyber risk mitigation to organizations in critical segments, so they can be safe from cyber threats. The CyberCatch platform focuses on solving the root cause of why cyberattacks are successful: security holes from control deficiencies. It first helps implement all mandated and necessary controls, then the platform automatically and continuously tests the controls from three dimensions (outside-in, inside-out and social engineering) to find control failures so one can fix them promptly to stay compliant and safe from attackers.
